name: ESP32 Hosted
description: ESP32 Hosted ([ESP-Hosted-MCU](https://github.com/espressif/esp-hosted-mcu)) is a solution that allows you to use ESP32 modules as communication co-processors. This solution provides wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi and Bluetooth) to the host module, enabling it to communicate with other devices.

config_entries.label: Type
config_entries.description: The update mode to use. Must be either embedded or http.

config_entries.label: Variant
config_entries.description: The variant of the ESP32 co-processor that is used by the host. One of `ESP32`, `ESP32S2`, `ESP32S3`, `ESP32C2`, `ESP32C3` and `ESP32C6`.

config_entries.label: Active High
config_entries.description: If enabled, the co-processor is active when reset is high. If disabled, the co-processor is active when reset is low.

config_entries.label: Clk Pin
config_entries.description: The SPI clock pin.

config_entries.label: Cmd Pin
config_entries.description: The SDIO command pin.

config_entries.label: CS Pin
config_entries.description: The SPI chip select pin.

config_entries.label: D0 Pin
config_entries.description: The SDIO D0 pin.

config_entries.label: D1 Pin
config_entries.description: The SDIO D1 pin. Required when `bus_width` is 4.

config_entries.label: D2 Pin
config_entries.description: The SDIO D2 pin. Required when `bus_width` is 4.

config_entries.label: D3 Pin
config_entries.description: The SDIO D3 pin. Required when `bus_width` is 4.

config_entries.label: Data Ready Pin
config_entries.description: The data ready pin used by the co-processor to signal available data.

config_entries.label: Handshake Pin
config_entries.description: The handshake pin used by the co-processor to signal readiness.

config_entries.label: MISO Pin
config_entries.description: The SPI MISO pin.

config_entries.label: MOSI Pin
config_entries.description: The SPI MOSI pin.

config_entries.label: Reset Pin
config_entries.description: The reset pin of the co-processor.

config_entries.label: Bus Width
config_entries.description: The SDIO bus width. Either `1` or `4`. Defaults to `4`.

config_entries.label: Data Ready Active High
config_entries.description: Polarity of the data ready signal. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Frequency
config_entries.description: The SPI clock frequency. Maximum depends on variant: 10MHz for ESP32, 40MHz for all other variants. Defaults to the maximum for each variant.

config_entries.label: Handshake Active High
config_entries.description: Polarity of the handshake signal. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Sdio Frequency
config_entries.description: Set the speed of communication between the host and the co-processor. If you experience loss of communication, or reboots, then try reducing this value. The value can be between 400kHz and 50MHz, with a default of 40MHz.

config_entries.label: Slot
config_entries.description: The SDIO slot number. Defaults to `1`.

config_entries.label: SPI Mode
config_entries.description: The SPI mode (0-3). Defaults depend on the variant: mode 2 for ESP32, mode 3 for all others.

config_entries.label: Use PSRAM
config_entries.description: Place the SPI transport buffer pool in PSRAM instead of internal RAM. Requires the host MCU to have DMA-capable PSRAM enabled (ESP32-P4, ESP32-S3). Recommended when the host firmware uses most of internal RAM (for example, a large LVGL UI); without it, boot can fail with an `spi_mempool_create` assert. Defaults to `false`.
